crossRefs.note: He said to them, “Depart for three days, then come back to me.” So the people departed.
Don’t say to your neighbor, “Go, and come again; tomorrow I will give it to you,” when you have it by you.

translations.web: He said to them, “Come again to me after three days.” So the people departed.
translations.bsb: Rehoboam answered, “Come back to me in three days.” So the people departed.
translations.kjv: And he said unto them, Come again unto me after three days. And the people departed.
translations.asv: And he said unto them, Come again unto me after three days. And the people departed.
